The Case Study
Garran Hill  ·  Pinehurst, NC

A source-backed editorial estate presentation.

Garran Hill is not a normal property page. It is a source-backed editorial estate presentation built from verified history, architectural evidence, restoration records, and photo-led storytelling.

Built in 1915–16 for Walter Hines Page — diplomat, publisher, Ambassador to the Court of St. James's. Listed at $4,250,000 by Sotheby's International Realty, Pinehurst.

View the Estate Site
What Rachel Studio Does
The Four Layers

Every listing is built on the same rigorous foundation.

Research

Verified provenance, source citations, historical guardrails, and public-safe copy. Every claim earns its place.

Media

Cloudinary photo systems, room tagging, narrative photo maps, mobile crop notes, and image-by-image captions.

Publishing

Luxury single-property websites with cinematic pacing, buyer facts, inquiry paths, mobile polish, and SEO foundations.

Stewardship

Rachel remains the taste, truth, and approval layer. AI assists production. Rachel protects the standard.

The Production System
Garran Hill — Production Layers

Everything visible
is backed by a system invisible to buyers.

The Garran Hill research citation document consolidates verified historical research and supersedes earlier drafts. The Cloudinary system organises 392 property photos — plus 11 locked hero assets — by room, act, photographer, and narrative use. Owner-provided notes and architectural drawings inform buyer-function facts and restoration details; private documents are never publicly exposed.
